title: D3D12 create_resource leaks reserved allocations on creation and option errors
body:
At main `fc22df05140b15ed6d764beabd12a1b807011bc5`, `Allocator::create_resource` allocates before checking placed-resource options and calling `CreatePlacedResource*`. Subsequent `?` returns abandon the suballocation. Repeated errors leave live bytes in allocator reports and consume reusable heap space until allocator destruction.

A deterministic public-API reproduction is to request a placed resource with castable formats but without enhanced barriers, then inspect `generate_report().total_allocated_bytes` after the error. Unsupported device-version/barrier combinations and native creation errors have the same ownership problem. Every failure after reservation should return the allocation.

[Independent fix and five public-constructor COM-stub regressions](https://github.com/simzy39/gpu-allocator/tree/fix/d3d12-resource-creation-rollback). Four tests fail on main and all five pass after the fix; strict Clippy and a Rust 1.71 consumer build pass. Tests check partial-resource destruction before backing-memory release and defensive null-success handling. A conforming native API is not expected to return success with null.

This fix needs no new sizing or cache APIs. Research, tests, implementation and this report were assisted by an OpenAI coding agent.
